summary: Chan (2003) test on 701,481 8-K filings vs daily bars, registered then run once. TEST 2015-01..2026-08, universe prev close >= $5 / ADV20 >= $50M: 13,939 ticker-days with day-0 excess >= +8%. Two thirds (9,262, 66%) have no 8-K of any item in reaction sessions T-1..T+1; 3,169 (23%) have an 8-K reacting on T (2,328 earnings 2.02, 841 other items); 1,508 ambiguous. 0 of 6 family cells pass. NEWS +8% movers do not continue: MOC-T entry net over SPY +0.12% at T+1 [-0.10, 0.38], -0.22% at T+5 [-0.68, 0.22], -0.18% at T+20 [-1.31, 1.06]; years positive 50/58/67%; Holm p 0.72/1.00/1.00. NO-NEWS +8% movers revert: -0.82% at T+5 with the whole CI below zero [-1.49, -0.10] (one-sided p 0.014, Holm 0.084), -1.59% at T+20 [-3.82, 0.70], positive in only 3 of 12 years (h5) and 2 of 12 (h20). NEWS minus NO-NEWS is +0.60% at h5 [-0.12, 1.25] and +1.40% at h20 [-0.07, 3.09] at the MOC-T entry (lower CI just misses zero); at the MOO-T+1 entry it clears zero at every horizon (+0.42/+0.87/+1.70%, lower CIs +0.13/+0.22/+0.25) because no-news names lose another -0.42% in the T+1 session. So: news moves are flat, no-news moves revert; the difference is entirely the no-news reversal, and the only actionable content is an exclusion rule, not a long. Down mirror: news-tagged -8% drops keep falling (-0.37% T+1 [-0.61, -0.15], -1.16% T+20 [-2.15, -0.18] long-side; non-2.02 news drops -2.48% at h20), no-news drops are flat (+0.04/+0.31/-0.24%), no bounce. Earnings 2.02 at h20 (+0.31%, +0.55% with the N5 exclusion, 75-83% of years positive) is the only positive-pointing long cell and is nowhere near clearing zero, matching PEAD. Answer to the operator: the mechanism is 'down to news' in that big moves without a public filing are the ones that revert, but knowing a move had an 8-K does not make it a tradeable continuation at 10-20 bp costs on this data; two thirds of the scanner's kind of moves have no filing at all and should be excluded from any continuation position.

by_item_type: Within NEWS UP8 TEST (MOC_T, descriptive, overlapping item categories): 2.02 earnings n 2328: h5 -0.18%, h20 +0.31% [-0.70, 1.35]; 7.01 Reg FD n 741: h5 -0.20%, h20 -0.50%; 8.01 other events n 611: h5 +0.72% [-0.27, 1.71], h20 -1.08%; 1.01 agreement n 268: h5 -1.01%, h20 -1.95%; 5.02 exec change n 231: h5 -1.92% [-3.56, -0.15], h20 -1.76%; 3.02 dilution at T n 78: h20 -7.79% [-13.47, -2.33]; 5.07 vote results n 65: h20 -5.24%; 2.03 debt n 90: h5 +1.23%, h20 +1.31% (CIs wide); 9.01-only n 11: h1 -3.53%. Non-2.02 news with a press-release-type item (7.01/8.01/1.01/2.01/...) n 710: h5 -0.04%, h20 -1.12%; non-2.02 routine-only items n 131: h5 -1.83%, h20 -3.82%. Intra-day filings are 100 of 3,169 NEWS events (3%) and do not drive the result. Type fixes the sign the way NEWSARCH predicted (dilution and exec-change filings are toxic, earnings mildly positive at h20) but no type is a positive long after costs.
exclusions_effect: N5 exclusion (any 3.02/4.02/3.01/1.03/5.03 filing with reaction session in [T-60, T]) removes 22% of UP8 events. TEST MOC_T: NEWS h1 +0.12 -> +0.03, h5 -0.22 -> -0.06, h20 -0.18 -> +0.45% [-0.70, 1.71]; NEWS_202 h20 +0.31 -> +0.55% [-0.40, 1.56]; NONEWS h5 -0.82 -> -0.57% [-1.22, 0.14], h20 -1.59 -> -0.93%. Every shift is inside the overlapping CIs, so by the registered rule the exclusion is not a proven improvement; it is defensible hygiene (3.02 dilution at T alone is -7.8% at h20) but no pass decision changes. Separately, the finding that supports an exclusion rule is the no-news arm itself: NONEWS UP8 reverts -0.82% at h5 with the whole CI below zero and is negative in 9 of 12 years, present in every ADV tier (h5 -0.56% at $50-100M to -1.92% above $2B) and in both regimes (2020-24 -0.67%, other -0.99%); ambiguous late-filer events behave the same (-0.77% h5, -1.88% h20).
caveats: Survivorship: symbol list as of 2026-09 for both bars and the filings crawl; delisted names are absent, which flatters every long cell and understates the no-news reversal (no-news pumps that later delist are missing). No haircut applied; NEWSARCH guidance is +0.25%/+0.40%.

'News' means any 8-K item, including routine ones (5.02 appointments, 5.07 vote results, 9.01-only); press releases that never became an 8-K, 6-K filers (foreign issuers), analyst actions, index changes and media coverage are invisible, so part of the NO-NEWS arm has a public catalyst this data cannot see. 722 filing tickers had no bars (33,501 filing rows dropped).

The registered difference test (MOC-T entry) misses zero at h5 (-0.12) and h20 (-0.07); it clears zero only at the MOO-T+1 entry, which was declared as a sub-cell but is outside the 6-cell Holm family. NONEWS h5 reversion has one-sided p 0.014 but Holm p 0.084, so it is a supported CI finding, not a Holm-corrected one.

Eligible universe per day jumps ~60% in 2025-2026 relative to 2024 (panel composition and/or volume growth), and 2025-26 contribute 39% of TEST UP8 events; both arms are negative in those years, so they weigh on all TEST means. Quarter-cluster CIs are very wide at h20 because 2020-2022 and 2025-26 dominate the event count.

Discovery 2005-2014 rests on 1,225 names and is descriptive only; the 2024-09-03..09-11 bars hole drops events and exits touching it; 10 of 16,465 UP8 events look like unadjusted-split ratios (negligible).
Intra-day 8-K filings on T (3% of NEWS) are counted as news even when accepted after the move; ambiguous events (8-K at T-1 or T+1 only) were excluded from both arms and behave like no-news.

DN8 rows are long-side net; a short would additionally pay borrow and both-way costs (news-drop short at h20 ~+0.9% with lower CI near -0.1%, not clearing zero). No stops, targets, halts or binary-event exclusions modelled.
